title: Floor Area Ratio
previewText:
The underlying floor area provisions shall apply except that:

the provisions applicable to sky exposure plane buildings, set forth in Section 23-73 (Special Provisions for Sky Exposure Plane Buildings), inclusive, shall not apply; and the maximum permitted floor area ratio for laboratories listed under Use Group VII shall be 3.40.
